title: GILT FRAMED OIL ON CANVAS OF A...
reason: Good sized decorative gum-tree landscape in a good gilt frame; the signature appears as the titled artist but nothing found to show it is a collectable name, so the value is mostly decorative.
findings: Oil on canvas, thickly painted, of a slab hut with a chimney beside a lake, large gum trees in the foreground and blue hills beyond (size 56 x 90 cm per the title). Signed lower right in white cursive, which appears to read 'L. Woodman' (matches the title, but the signature is only about 90 pixels wide so it is not independently legible; a quick web search on 19/10/2026 found no listed artist of that name). Style is typical decorative Australiana of roughly the 1970s to 1990s. The frame is an ornate gilt composition style moulding with floral and scroll decoration and a plain liner, in good order. The back, labels and any gallery or exhibition stickers are not shown. Treat the attribution as unverified.
condition: Painting looks clean with no visible tears, holes or flaking at photo resolution; frame corners look sound with no obvious loss of gilding. Surface and back are not shown.
rescore_note: Decorative gum tree and slab hut oil of the common 1970s-90s Australiana type, large with a good ornate gilt frame; signature not legible at photo size and no listed artist known by that name, so no attribution premium. Realistic value at the top of the $30-80 band, with the frame doing much of the work. (No fresh comps, search limit hit.)
